data.title: Ammonium lactate 12% lotion
data.summary: VI Keratolytics & emollients · α-hydroxy acid (lactic acid neutralised with ammonium hydroxide)
data.body:
_Topicals · VI Keratolytics & emollients_

**Class:** α-hydroxy acid (lactic acid neutralised with ammonium hydroxide)

## Mechanism of action
- Humectant (lactic acid is part of natural moisturising factor) and mild keratolytic (reduces corneocyte cohesion)
- Buffered (pH about 4.5–5.5) → less stinging than plain lactic acid

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Xerosis, ichthyosis vulgaris (FDA approved), keratosis pilaris, cracked heels, palmoplantar hyperkeratosis

## Dose & formulations
- Apply twice daily, rub in thoroughly

## Adverse effects
- Stinging and burning on fissured or inflamed skin; erythema
- Photosensitivity — sun protection advised

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity; face (relative); broken skin

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Buffered lactic acid — approved for ichthyosis vulgaris and xerosis

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.52 and ch.55; Khopkar ch.27. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
